Thanks Alex — looping in what we'll need and the recommended path.

Checklist / next steps:
1) Customer-signed PO (received) + confirmed AWS billing contact (received).
2) Redwood to publish a Private Offer draft in AWS Marketplace (we'll create the PO line items to match the 3-tranche activation). AWS supports "metered activation" if we model the tranches as separate line items with start dates; that will create separate invoice lines.
3) Credits for unused committed capacity: AWS billing does not provide an automatic carry-forward credit in the private offer flow. Recommended approach: we can set up a monthly reconciliation and issue Redwood credits (applied as credit memos) for any unused committed spend, documented in the SOW and reflected in our internal billing. We'll include language in the private offer annex to make this explicit.
4) Legal (Marissa), please review the draft private offer and the proposed credit-addendum language (I attached the marketplace checklist).
5) Target timeline: Draft Private Offer in AWS by 2026-09-04; internal legal sign-off by 2026-09-07; DocuSign out to customer by 2026-09-08; expected signed back by 2026-09-10. Acceptance staging complete by 2026-11-01.
